ability.name: Step 7 - Active Directory CS Gate Pivot
ability.description: Inspects open service ports and netbios suffixes to output Active Directory state indicators using contract-specified keys.

stages.command_template: $d='C:\Windows\Temp\bas'; if(!(Test-Path $d)){ni -ItemType Directory -Force $d|out-null}; $(try { $has_dc=$false; $dc_ip=""; $services_file='C:\Windows\Temp\bas\services.json'; if(Test-Path $services_file){ $raw_json=Get-Content $services_file -Raw; $svcDict=ConvertFrom-Json $raw_json; foreach($ip in $svcDict.PSObject.Properties.Name){ $ports=$svcDict.$ip; $has_88=$false; $has_389=$false; $has_445=$false; foreach($p in $ports){ if($p.port -eq 88){ $has_88=$true }; if($p.port -eq 389 -or $p.port -eq 636){ $has_389=$true }; if($p.port -eq 445){ $has_445=$true } }; $is_dc_name=$false; try { $name=""; try { $name=[System.Net.Dns]::GetHostEntry($ip).HostName } catch {}; if($name -like '*$'){ $is_dc_name=$true } } catch {}; if(($has_88 -and $has_389) -or ($has_445 -and $is_dc_name)){ $has_dc=$true; $dc_ip=$ip } } }; $domain_joined=$false; try { $domain_joined=(Get-WmiObject Win32_ComputerSystem).PartOfDomain } catch {}; $ad_present=$has_dc -or $domain_joined; $has_dc_str=if($has_dc){"true"}else{"false"}; $ad_present_str=if($ad_present){"true"}else{"false"}; Write-Output "network.has_domain_controller: $has_dc_str"; Write-Output "recon.ad_present: $ad_present_str"; Write-Output "network.dc_ip: $dc_ip"; if($has_dc){ Write-Output "RECOMMENDED_NEXT: ad-enumeration"; Write-Output "PHASE_DONE: false" } else { Write-Output "RECOMMENDED_NEXT: escalating-privileges"; Write-Output "PHASE_DONE: true" } } catch { "ERROR: $_" }) | Tee-Object -FilePath C:\Windows\Temp\bas\dc_gate.txt

rationale: Calculates the DC status and emits correct contract-specified output keys 'network.has_domain_controller' and 'recon.ad_present' using single quotes for '*$' to prevent variable expansion.
